claims.text: The intrusion attempts coming from 5.188.10.180 and 185.190.58.151 exhibit distinct patterns, with the former displaying a more rapid succession of attempts.
The 5.188.10.180 IP address produces 30 lines of log entries within a span of approximately 1 minute and 18 seconds, indicating a high-frequency burst of activity.
In contrast, the 185.190.58.151 IP address generates 26 lines of log entries over a period of roughly 6 minutes, demonstrating a more spaced-out and prolonged series of attempts.
Both sources attempt to access the system using various usernames, including "admin", "0", "123", and "1234", with the 5.188.10.180 IP address also trying "default", "ftp", and "guest".
The 185.190.58.151 IP address, on the other hand, also attempts to access the system using the username "api".

The repetition of failed password attempts for the "admin" user from both IP addresses, without any intervening successful logins or changes in behavior, suggests that these errors recur without a corrective action in between.
